allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Ethan learns he carries the spirit of a warrior who battled dragons in 16th-century Korea -- and one day he'll find a tattooed girl carrying the spirit of that warrior's beloved. Years later, he meets Sarah and dragons soon descend on Los Angeles seeking out the two souls of the ancient lovers.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can two reincarnated souls survive an ancient grudge when legendary beasts tear through a contemporary city to find them?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Bound to a 16th-century warrior's spirit, Ethan tracks down Sarah, the reincarnated soul of his ancient love, just as monstrous dragons descend upon modern Los Angeles in a fierce hunt for the couple.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and action-heavy, blending fantasy spectacle with the relentless energy of a creature invasion.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Shim Hyung-rae orchestrates a brisk, 90-minute spectacle fusing ancient Korean legend with high-octane creature-feature destruction in modern urban streets.
